summary: Merges geometry from multiple SOPs into one SOP output. Inputs can be wired directly or gathered by the SOPs parameter with wildcard pattern matching for large same-name sets.

key_params.name: sops
key_params.note: SOPs parameter; optional SOP path/name patterns to merge in addition to wired inputs, with wildcard Pattern Matching support.

common_gotchas: The SOPs parameter supports wildcard Pattern Matching; broad patterns can accidentally pull in helper SOPs, so prefer stable names or explicit wired inputs for critical geometry.
Merge SOP does not fuse overlapping points or weld surfaces; use Fuse SOP or topology tools afterward when the downstream network needs connected geometry.
A Merge SOP can reduce render batch count when merged SOPs share the same material and can be rendered with a single draw command.
Do not use Merge SOP as a blanket optimization when inputs cook every frame; the merge cook can cost more than rendering extra batches.
Use Object Merge SOP when source component transforms should be baked, and Select SOP when a direct reference to a stable SOP endpoint is enough.
